notes.title: Update 1.9.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.9.0
After a slight delay, the time has finally come. The next update is ready. The biggest new feature in this update is the new game mode "Quick Battle." For now, there are only two maps (one on Grimstar and one on Atell). All upgrades are unlocked in this mode. You can freely choose the difficulty and opponent. Loading and saving are also possible, of course.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/a9ac6ba3b4b8a6c2d7a9b19749a6c35a0dc8ea38.png"]
Changes that have been implemented
The range of the Mini Gun has been increased

New game mode "Quick Battle"
Bugs that have been fixed
In some places, the maps on Atell were not properly accessible, and units would get stuck on the map. This has been fixed.
What happens next?
The next update is planned to add more content, such as new upgrades, units, and buildings. There will also be more maps for the "Quick Battle" game mode.

Due to the summer holidays in Germany, the next update won't be released until the end of September. Unless, of course, critical bugs have crept in.

notes.title: Update 1.8.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.8.0
As announced, the first update is now available with the first new content. This includes a new unit, a new upgrade, and a new building.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/d092cf3149587ff53b45026cd4f47f720b1287e1.png"]
Changes that have been implemented
New upgrade "Radar" that allows you to reveal parts of the map for a short time.

New unit "Drone." This is a fast unit with a long visibility range but is unarmed.

New building "Watchtower." This building is heavily armored and can be manned by soldiers.

The first mission has been slightly revised and is now easier to complete.
What happens next?
The next update plans to add more content, such as new upgrades, units and buildings.

notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.7.0
First of all, thank you again for the extensive and detailed feedback I received from you on the last update. Based on your feedback, I've implemented further changes in a subsequent update and have also been able to fix some critical bugs.


Bugs that have been fixed
Friendly units no longer disappear into the walls in the indoor mission on Atel.

Missing Russian and Chinese translations have been added and corrected.


Changes that have been implemented
You can set waypoints for your own units when moving them (using the Add key)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/33fa19a7fb74cd8d59ff3771a805b3ef541df592.png"]

The "Bloom" effect can now be reduced or completely turned off in the display settings

The silhouette from the last update can now be deactivated in the settings

The penultimate mission has been slightly reworked and is now less difficult to complete.
What happens next?
The next update is planned to add some more content, such as new upgrades, units and buildings.

notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.0
Thank you very much for the numerous and detailed feedback I've received from you. This is a great help in further improving the game. Based on your feedback, I've implemented initial changes in the update and have also been able to identify and fix critical bugs.


Bugs that have been fixed
The enemy AI has been revised and balanced. A few bugs have been fixed. For example, the pirates were able to build new units with almost no resources. Additionally, some units would sometimes get stuck in the enemy base, resulting in far too many units waiting in the base and making it almost impossible to destroy pirate bases (except with the plasma cannon). In some missions, enemy units could shoot through walls with factories, and due to the bug, they weren't automatically attacked by their own units.

Maintenance units and worker drones now return to the location where the player placed them after automatically repairing units and buildings. This prevents them from accidentally spreading across the map.

The bug where you could no longer select the next mission after completing the 3rd mission on Atell (the screen remained partially black) has been fixed.


Changes that have been implemented
Friendly units now have a silhouette to make them easier and faster to spot. This silhouette is visible even when units are behind trees or buildings. Enemy units also have this silhouette, but in red. This makes units and enemies much more visible, for example, when fighting in the forest.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40670625/f00119daad761b25e7d2704a35b7910698b19f63.png"]

If you select unit groups using the number key and press this key twice, the camera jumps directly to the unit group
What happens next?
Further updates are planned every two weeks to provide new content in addition to further improvements. Additional units, towers, and other upgrades are planned. There will also be new enemy units and buildings.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.2 is Available
notes.notes:
Patch 1.5.2
A new patch is available that fixes critical bugs that occur when loading or saving game states. For example, various towers disappear after loading. A few minor issues occurred, especially when loading or saving special missions. I've fixed these with this patch.
What's next?
In addition to further patches, there will also be a major update next month. The update will include UI improvements for faster summoning of new units. There will also be new units and towers. Details on the planned update will be available in the coming days. Thank you for your feedback and for reporting bugs; it really helps me improve the game.

notes.title: Release date June 16, 2025
notes.notes:
Release date: June 16, 2025, for GRIMSTAR: Crystals are the New Oil!

[previewyoutube=AylRCK6DYP8;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, after about five years of development, the release date has finally been set.
For those who can't wait, try the demo while you're there; you can play the first missions and get an overview of the game.

Grimstar: Crystals are the New Oil! tells the story of the year 3047.
Earth's resources are depleted, and an energy crisis is imminent. But there is still hope—the discovery of a distant world rich in a new type of natural energy resource. The name of the new world is "Grimstar." Your brother was killed there, and the laws of the corporation he worked for require you to take his place until his contract is fulfilled. So, you set out to fulfill your duty and find out more about your brother's death...

Wishlist and Follow The release is just around the corner!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631230/Grimstar_Crystals_are_the_New_Oil/

Ask the Developer
You are cordially invited to join our Discord server to discuss the game more or to share feedback and bugs you've found.
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Grimstar: Prequel. Update 1.4.0 is available!
notes.notes:
Hello, Corporates!

The Grimstar: Prequel update 1.4.0 has been released. I would like to thank you again for all your feedback on Steam and Discord, which also made this update possible. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631250/Grimstar_Prequel/

The following are some of the major changes:

New Map Design
A new Optical Map Design has been added, with more objects on the map. The maps should no longer look so empty.

[previewyoutube=zEKJw0vvptg;full][previewyoutube=zEKJw0vvptg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Balancing
There have been further balancing improvements made to the new enemy and player fractions. There has also been a slight update to the existing mission maps.

Bug fixing
A number of bugs have been fixed, allowing the game to run more smoothly. One critical bug was fixed during the loading of new missions. The process has been sped up and shouldn't be interrupted any longer.

Any feedback you have about the new update would be greatly appreciated!

I look forward to seeing you out there, on the surface of a savage planet!

Ask The Dev
You are very welcome to join our Discord server to discuss more about the game.

notes.title: Grimstar: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello RTS fans!

As you've probably noticed, we've pushed back the release date of Full Version to Q1 next year. My goal is to make the Full Version of the game better using all the feedback you provide. Aside from identifying the key issues and improving all aspects of the game, your input helps us greatly with optimizations and bug fixing. As you can guess all of this takes a lot of time (especially when only one guy develops a game (-;)), so we have to move the release date of the Full Version once more. 

I hope you understand that I strive for the highest quality possible when the Full Version is released. 

At the beginning of December, we released Version 1.3.0 of the Free Version, which includes all optimizations. Please test it and let me know what you think. As I mentioned, this would also be very helpful in improving the Full Version. 

Here is a video with excerpts from a few missions from the full version as a small consolation:
[previewyoutube=ZawBuVvuIIo;full][/previewyoutube]

See you soon, Commander!
